children: The glory days of growth are behind, but the $4.6 trln company may find a new way to goose revenue with a foldable handset. Call it the bifocal iPhone. Millennials, the largest US generation, are just hitting the age when nearly everyone develops problems reading small text.
Full view will be published shortly.
Apple is expected to introduce a foldable iPhone with a price tag of more than $2,000 at an event on September 9, according to multiple media reports.
